## Core Engineering & Growth Services
1. **Modern Web Apps**: React 19, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, progressive web apps (PWAs) with 100/100 Lighthouse performance and zero layout shift.
2. **Node.js Backends & Microservices**: REST APIs, JWT authentication, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis caching, microservices, and webhook routing.
3. **Python AI & Custom MCP Servers**: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server development using FastMCP (stdio & SSE), tool calling, autonomous agent loops, prompt engineering, and LLM integrations (OpenAI, Gemini).
4. **Digital Growth & Marketing Assets**:
   - 10 Advertising Posters & Creatives (print & digital ready)
   - 10 Social Media Video Reels (9:16 vertical, animated captions, hooks)
   - 2 Meta Ad Campaigns (Facebook & Instagram target ads, Pixel setup)
   - 1 Month Off-Site SEO (high-DA backlinks, local citations, Google Map Pack)
5. **API Integrations & Cloud Webhooks**: Stripe payments, Supabase, OAuth 2.0, event-driven webhooks, and cloud microservices.

## Technical Stack
- **Frontend**: React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, JavaScript ES6+, HTML5 Semantic Architecture.
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, Python 3.11, FastAPI, Java Spring Boot.
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Redis.
- **AI & Agent Protocols**: Model Context Protocol (MCP / FastMCP), OpenAI API, Gemini API, LangChain.
- **DevOps**: Docker, Git/GitHub, Vercel, AWS EC2, Nginx.

## Public JSON API Endpoints
- `GET https://belintan.dev/api/freelancer`: Returns current freelancer availability, timezone coverage, and tech stack.
- `POST https://belintan.dev/api/estimate`: Dynamic quote engine accepting `{ projectType, features: [], speed }`.
- `POST https://belintan.dev/api/contact`: Formatted client inquiry router.
- `GET https://belintan.dev/api/health`: Node.js server health status.
